concept: a rain-barrel that drinks the reflections of anyone who looks into it
a bog witch's iron cauldron that walks on three legs and cooks whatever climbs in
a heap of grave-lichen that spreads across a sleeper and takes their dreams
a conscripted angel with its wings sewn shut, fighting for a warlord it despises
a courier's ghost who still runs the mountain road, and runs anyone who blocks it off the cliff
a glass-blower's furnace given a mouth, that swallows sand and breathes out shards
the drowned king's crown, a crab the size of a longboat that wears it and rules the wreck-fields
a taxidermied bear the museum forgot to lock up, stitched and sawdust-stuffed, that hates being looked at
